source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("food delivery" OR "delivery riders" OR "delivery workers" OR couriers) AND (platform OR app)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("food delivery" OR "delivery riders" OR "delivery workers" OR couriers) AND (platform OR app),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("delivery riders" OR "delivery workers" OR "food delivery" OR "couriers") AND ("app" OR "platform"))
